description: Every field a call to graph may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

directory.description: the project folder, filled by Craft; never the model's

imports.description: modules the conformances import, such as the package a mapped type is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Components/Graph when left out

launch.description: the state the root opens in for a launch with `-destination <name>`, one a line: `atlas = graph(space-001, space-002)`; states graph and text, each with the ids it loads in parentheses (none: the page's own)

look.description: look roles mapped to the app's names, one a line: `title = Font.brandTitle`; roles title, note, note2, passage (Font), accent, foreground, hubBadge, leafBadge (Color); an unmapped role is the system's

mappings.description: one line a role (node, edge): `node: GraphNode id=id level=level text=text neighbours=neighborIds`, `edge: Link from=source to=target`; a bare path is read off the value, anything else is Swift that may name `value`

prefix.description: what the kit's names start with instead of Graph, when the app already has those names: `Wiki` writes WikiView

strings.description: the words, one a line, `key = words` (quotes optional): `title = Atlas`, `hub = L{level} Hub`, `loading = Connecting…`; `title =` with nothing after it draws no title; every key and its default in Graph.md

tuning.description: numbers, symbols and motion, one a line: `hubRadius = 0.45`, `excerpt = 240`, `pulseScale = 1.12`, `showAnimation = .spring(response: 0.4, dampingFraction: 0.8)`; `layout = force` stands the nodes where their links pull them instead of round a circle (`layoutSeed = 7` picks its starts); `hubLeaves = named` puts out only the leaves an open hub names itself; every key in Graph.md
